Four distinct designs from top to bottom, each one repeated across its own horizontal row as four subtly different animation keyframes from left to right. Each icon must stay entirely inside the central 65% of its equal square cell. Centers at 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5% of width and height. All gutters transparent and equal. Invisible grid. No text captions, numbers, grid lines, background tiles or opaque shadows. Each frame designed as a true tiny 28x28 pixel sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor. Large square pixel clusters, chunky navy contour and a few bright ivory edge lights for visibility on dark glass, clean flat limited 8-12 colors per sprite, no antialiasing, gradients, or glow. Make original hand-drawn game art for a Cobblemon trainer quest book. Use a different strong silhouette for each row. No copying existing sprite artwork. EXACT row specifications, 4 columns share one fixed shape and anchor, only the specified small moving details vary:
ROW 1 from top, all four cells: Champion Jax insignia: a gold trophy bracketed by two tiny sky-blue battle gems for his double battle, letter J on its blue central plaque. Animation left to right: two battle gems flash alternately, finishing near the starting pose.
ROW 2 from top, all four cells: Shadow Admin Ivory insignia: ivory crescent mask with a pointed violet eye slit, set against a short dark officer collar. Animation left to right: one violet eye glints, finishing near the starting pose.
ROW 3 from top, all four cells: Shadow Admin Marlon insignia: deep blue shield with a silver lightning slash, slate mask and bright cyan eye detail. Animation left to right: cyan light travels down the silver slash, finishing near the starting pose.
ROW 4 from top, all four cells: Shadow Boss Zeph insignia: dark indigo-crowned eclipse with bright coral rim and three shadow spikes. Animation left to right: coral crescent shifts around eclipse, finishing near the starting pose.
Check before final: sixteen centered isolated pixel sprites total, four horizontal rows of four, no labels, genuine transparent empty space between every icon on all sides.
